_doc: Bosch Rexroth's T-nut for its 8 mm slot, M5 (3 842 501 752). Fmax is Rexroth's for the M6.
name: slot-nut-8-bosch-m5-drop-in

slot.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4

thread.rule: Thread M5, one of the sizes the table lists (M4, M5, M6)
thread.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4

nut_kind.rule: Dropped in through the opening and turned until it stops: Rexroth's T-nut
nut_kind.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4

length.rule: Along the slot once turned: 8 on the drawing
length.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4

width.rule: Across the slot once turned: 16.5 on the drawing, as wide as the cavity: it turns until it jams
width.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4

height.rule: The body under the lips: 6 on the drawing
height.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4

tongue_height.rule: The step into the opening: 1.5 on the drawing
tongue_height.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4

nut_entry.rule: Put in through the opening anywhere along the slot
nut_entry.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4

material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its T-nut in an 8 mm slot (M6) at 4000 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m5 thread set (ISO 898-1)
